verses.text: Ha in Jeremías in tik schekab' in Dios, ix wak'b'at jun in carta t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', t'a heb' sacerdote, t'a heb' schekab' Dios yet' t'a masanil anima aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor t'a Babilonia.

Ix wak'b'at jun carta tik, ayik toxo ix ik'jib'at winhaj rey Jeconías t'a Babilonia chi' yet' ix reina, haton ix snun winh. Ix ik'jipaxb'at heb' smunlaj t'a palacio, heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén, heb' jelan sb'o'an tastak yet' pax heb' tenum k'e'en.

Ix ik'jib'at jun carta tik yuj winhaj Elasa yuninal winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Gemarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Haton heb' winh tik ix chekjib'at yuj winhaj Sedequías sreyal Judá t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha jun carta chi', icha tik syala':
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia yuj ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, haton Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alan t'ayex icha tik:
B'o'ek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze lo'an sat.
Hak'ekoch eyetb'eyum, aljokab' eyuninal. Ochokab' pax yetb'eyum heb' eyuninal chi', aljokab' pax yuninal heb', k'ib'okab' he b'isul, mokab' emta he b'isul chi'.
Munlajanhek yuj swach'ilok jun chonhab' b'aj ix ex wak'b'at chi'. k'anek in kolwal t'a yib'anh, tato wach' tz'aj jun chonhab' chi', wach' pax ol ex aj yet'ok.

Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in, a in swal juntzanh tik: Manh eyak' he b'a musansatil yuj juntzanh heb' syesejoch sb'a in chekab'ok yet' heb' na'umel lolonel yalani. Manh he cha eyab' swayich heb' syala'.
Ha tas syal heb' chi' t'a in b'i, nab'a es. Ha in Jehová in swala' to manhok in tzin chek yal heb'.
Swalanxi: Ayik ol tz'akwok 70 ab'il yak'an yajalil Babilonia chi', ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'ayex, ol wak'anpaxelk'och b'aj ix wak' in ti' to ol ex wik'xi meltzaj t'a tik.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala', wojtak tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Ha tas nab'il chi' wu'uj, manh yujok eyab'an syahelal, palta yuj he wach'ilok yik wach' ay tas tzeyak'och yipok he k'ol t'a b'ak'inh.
Ol lajwok chi', ol eyal he b'a t'ayin, ol ex lesalwok t'ayin, ol wab'an he lesal chi'.
Ha in wal Jehová in swala' to ol ex jawok t'ayin, ol in ch'ox in b'a t'ayex, yujto ol eyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab' t'a smasanil he k'o'ol.

Ha in Jehová in swala', ol in ch'oxnhej in b'a t'ayex. Ol in k'ex tas eyaji. Ol ex wik'kot t'a masanil nación yet' t'a masanil b'aj ix ex in saklemejkanb'ati. Ol ex in molb'ej, ol ex wik'anpax meltzaj b'aj ayex ek' kajan ayik ix ex ik'jib'ati, xchi Jehová.
Ha ex tik tzeyala': Ayxo heb' schekab' Jehová t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik, xe chi.

Palta syal Jehová icha tik t'a yib'anh winh rey ayoch t'a sdespachokan winhaj rey David yet' t'a heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' tik, haton juntzanh heb' ayto eyuj he b'a yet'ok, heb' maj ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi':
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol wak'b'at owal, wejel yet' ilya t'a skal heb'. Lajan ol wutejkan heb' icha juntzanh te' higo k'a'eltakxo, te chuklaj, maxtzak yal sloji.

Ol in pechb'eyek' heb' yuj owal, yuj wejel, yuj pax ilya. Ol wak'an yajjok heb' yuj masanil nación. Ol ja katab' t'a yib'anh heb', ol xiw heb' anima yuj heb' ayik ol yilanoch heb'. Ol b'uchwaj heb' t'a heb', ol b'ajjok heb' yuj juntzanh nación b'aj ol in saklemejkanb'ati.
Ha in Jehová in swala' to tzijtum el ix alji t'a heb' yuj heb' in chekab', palta maj scha yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' in chekab' chi'. Hanhejtona' ex pax tik maj he chapax eyab'i.
E masanil ex aj Jerusalén ix ex wak' ik'jokb'at t'a Babilonia, ab'ek wal in lolonel swala'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, he Diosal in paxi, swal yuj winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Colaías yet' yuj winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Maasías, haton heb' winh tz'alan juntzanh esal lolonel t'a in b'i: Ol wak'och heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia. Ha winh ol chekan miljokcham heb' winh t'a eyichanh.

Yuj chi', ex aj Judá, ex ik'b'il ex b'at t'a Babilonia, tato ayex ol he nib'ej he katab'ej junok mach, ol eyal icha tik: Ach yutejokab' Jehová icha utajnak winhaj Sedequías yet' winhaj Acab, haton heb' winh scheknak winhaj Nabucodonosor nhusjoktz'a'ok, xe chama.

Icha chi' ol aj sja t'a yib'anh heb' winh, yujto te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' winh t'a yol he chonhab'. Tz'em heb' winh ajmulal yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' yetwinakil. Syalan juntzanh esal lolonel heb' winh t'a in b'i, manhok in tzin chek yal heb' winh. Ha in Jehová in swala', wojtak tas yaji, xchi Jehová, xin chib'at t'a jun in carta chi'.

Ay jun winh skuchan Semaías aj Nehelam ayek' t'a Babilonia chi'. T'a yol yik winh ix yak'kot jun carta t'a masanil heb' anima kajantokan t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a winhaj sacerdote Sofonías yuninal winhaj Maasías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote. Ha t'a jun carta chi' ix yalkot winh t'a winhaj Sofonías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios ix ach ak'anoch sacerdote'al sk'exulok winhaj Joiada, yik wach' kuchb'um tzach aj t'a stemplo. Tato ay mach sk'och t'ayach aykot t'a sjolom tz'och ijan slolon icha heb' schekab' Dios. Ha jun chi' elanhchamel tzak'och t'a yol te' cepo, tza tzek'an yet' k'e'en cadena. ¿Tas yuj maj a kach winhaj Jeremías aj Anatot? Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh slolon t'a ichanh, icha schekab' Dios syutej sb'a winh, yujto ix yak'kot jun carta winh t'ayonh t'a Babilonia tik. Syalan winh icha tik: Najtilto ol ex kajnaj ta'. B'o'ek he pat, tzex kajnaj t'ay, awejek eyawb'en te' yik tze lo'an sat, xchi jun scarta winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi scarta winhaj Semaías chi'. Ix yawtan jun carta chi' winhaj sacerdote Sofonías wab' a in Jeremías in tik. Ixlajwi chi', a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ix lolon t'ayin. Ix yalan icha tik: Alb'at t'a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a Babilonia to a in swal icha tik: Ha winhaj Semaías aj Nehelam, winh ix halani to a in ix in chek yal winh to toxo ol meltzaj winh t'a Babilonia chi'. Palta manhok in ix in chek yal jun esal lolonel winh ix eyak'och yipok he k'ol chi'. Yuj chi', a in Jehová in swala' to ol wak' syahelal winhaj Semaías chi' yet' pax heb' yinhtilal. Manhxalaj junok yinhtilal winh chi' ol aj t'a skal heb' in chonhab', yik syak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol t'a in wach'k'olal ol wak' t'ayex, yujto ix ex skuchb'ej winh yik tze pitej he b'a t'ayin, xchi Jehová, xa chib'ati, xchi t'ayin.
